note: Newest first. tools/release.py publishes the first entry as the live 'latest' record that running apps watch.

notes: Clear HIVE: the polycarbonate skins are see-through like the real ones, with reflections at an angle
A real game menu: a live AI match plays behind the main menu; match setup, pause menu (Esc / Start), and a results screen with Play again
Settings, saved in your browser: graphics presets and options, camera, rebindable keys, volumes, auto-aim on/off, accessibility
Better, more accurate graphics: soft shadows from the light rig, the official CAD colour on every field part, AprilTags on the HIVE, detailed robots with mecanum wheels and a hooded shooter
Robot sounds, a status strip with the shooter light and the balls you hold, and much faster rendering
Fixed: the HIVE, FLOWERS, field barrier and the holes in the balls were missing in claude.ai (blocked asset loading)
Your robot can score: the flywheel always spins; hold Space / A to fire - it turns to face your HIVE and shoots when ready
WASD drives, arrow keys turn; your view follows your robot and looks down when it comes close
Pick where you stand on a top view of the field before the match
Crashing into the barrier rocks the robot, flexes the wall and thuds; better metal and lighting
Shooter assist: hold R / RB and the flywheel and hood follow your distance to your HIVE; a light on the robot turns green when ready
Touch controls for phones and tablets
Match sound cues, an AUTO hint, Leave match (Esc)
Graphics step down automatically if the frame rate drops
Arena lighting rig over the field; the field sits in a night forest clearing
Clear polycarbonate refracts; HIVE skins let a little light through
Official CAD field and perforated POLLEN / NECTAR; balls stay visible inside robots
Update notices: a bar when a new version is out, and Check for updates under About
